name: Herdr Planner
author: Aleksey Abaydulin
description: Herdr Planner in the bar: counters of herdr-projects board tasks waiting on you and under review; a click opens a popup with the projects and their tasks by stage, a project click opens it in the planner.

barWidget.description: Waiting / review counters from the local herdr-planner service (127.0.0.1) and a popup with the board's projects and their tasks by stage (what waits on you first); hidden while the service does not answer.
